name: Naoshima
tagline: Art island of the Seto Inland Sea
summary: Naoshima is a small island turned into a world of contemporary art. See Monet's Water Lilies in Tadao Ando's underground Chichu Art Museum, the yellow pumpkin by Yayoi Kusama on the pier, the Art House Project inside old village houses, and bathe in the art bathhouse I♥湯, then hop to Teshima for its teardrop art museum.
seasonNote: Spring and autumn are best; the Setouchi Triennale draws crowds in festival years; most museums close on Mondays.
arrival: Ferries from Uno port (1 hour from Okayama by train) take 20 minutes, or from Takamatsu 50 minutes.
gettingAround: Rent a bike or e-bike; island buses link the port, Honmura and Benesse.
cashTip: Cards and IC cards work in most places, but carry cash for small restaurants, shrines and rural buses. No tipping.
foodTip: Seto Inland Sea seafood and sanuki udon on the way via Takamatsu.

connections.note: Shinkansen to Okayama, train to Uno, ferry.
